title: W3Schools: Set Difference
description: Given two lists `a` and `b`, return the set difference `a - b` (elements in a but not in b) as a sorted list of unique values.
constraints:
0 <= len(a), len(b) <= 10^4
• Time: O(N log N) | Space: O(N)
starter_code:
def set_difference(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    pass
solution:
def set_difference(a: list[int], b: list[int]) -> list[int]:
    return sorted(list(set(a) - set(b)))
explanation: Set subtraction removes elements of b from a, sorted in O(N log N) time.
